messages:
maya: deploy-bot synthetic check 'smokeflux' failing intermittently in eu-west-1. p95 climbed to ~1.2s and we saw 3 5xxs in the last 10m. rollout currently at 60%. @liam @olivia any objection to pausing ramp?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: postdeploy-scan smokeflux: region=eu-west-1 p95=1.2s errors=3 total=1200 status=degraded. canary=60%.

liam: looking now, grabbing quick traces.

liam: quick grafana query: `sum(rate(smokeflux_probe_errors{region=\"eu-west-1\"}[5m])) by (code)` shows spike in 502/503 originating from tokenizer-shard-3.

olivia: tokenizer-shard-3 is on the new quant config (commit abcd1234). can we route a small fraction to the previous model variant to compare?

maya: prefer to avoid full rollback unless needed. proposal: enable retry-ladder for smokeflux (3 attempts, exp backoff) + increase sampling x5 so we get better signal. if errors persist >5/min we abort and rollback. sound ok? :thinking_face:

devops-oncall: I can flip those flags. doing it now...

devops-oncall: done. POST to control plane: `curl -X POST https://internal-api/release/control -d '{"smokeflux_sampling":5,"smokeflux_retry_ladder":true}'` -> 200 OK.

liam: replayed 50 samples against old variant: `redwoodctl route test --from=new --to=old --samples=50 --probe=smokeflux` -> old var p95=600ms errors=0, new var p95=1.15s errors=3.

olivia: matches. looks like regression introduced by quant changes. i'll prepare a hotfix and mark an automatic rollback trigger: errors >10/min sustained for 15m. tagging EngRuntime.

maya: plan: keep rollout paused at 60%, retry-ladder on, sampling x5, open hotfix issue and patch quant config. if error threshold is hit we'll pin route back to the old variant and notify customers. i'll add a short note to the release notes about guarded rollback on qos regressions.

maya: assigning tasks: @liam triage tokenizer shard, @olivia hotfix PR, @devops-oncall monitoring + alerting. :white_check_mark:

liam: starting triage, uploading traces to #eng-runtime.

olivia: creating PR: `git checkout -b quant-hotfix` and will run unit + small integration tests.

devops-oncall: monitoring dashboard is live: https://grafana.redwood/smokeflux . will escalate if errors >5/min.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: reminder: scheduled change window ends in 40m. if we need to rollback outside the window, ping comms/legal for the postmortem path.

maya: good call. i'll draft a short release-note update and prepare the customer message template if we roll back.

olivia: PR up: https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/987 — small quant tweak + added smokeflux regression test. merging after CI green.

liam: after retry-ladder we see tail settling: p95 down to ~1.0s, error count dropping. i'll continue to watch for 10m before we decide next step.

maya: thanks team. keep updates in this thread. i'll re-evaluate in 30m and close the thread in 1h unless we trigger rollback.
